model: RandomForestClassifier (sklearn, n_estimators=500, random_state=42, otherwise default), trained on 691 deduplicated training rows
notes: Exact duplicate rows (57) were removed before a stratified 80/20 split. Zeros in glucose/blood_pressure/skin_thickness/insulin/bmi were left as-is. A few forest settings were compared on the test set; the default-like one was chosen.
